about: Hand labels for research.section_relevant (tools/jev_measure.py sections). A section counts as relevant when its text contains any phrase in `any_of`. Questions are paraphrased so they do not copy the doc's headings.

pairs.question: What happens if I try to merge a change that nobody has looked at?
What choices does the independent checker have when it finishes?
Which safety hook stops a session from running commands in the wrong checkout?
How was the overnight storage crisis on the build machine handled?
Which two tests touch the login keychain?
Is it risky that anyone's pushed branch executes on the owner's computer?
Who signs the app archive and with what certificate?
Why is a stock simulator heavy and how is it trimmed?
How do I make sure a change appears in the release text?
What does a version string look like once it is displayed in the app?
What if several uploads are waiting at the same time?
any_of: one pending run per concurrency group

pairs.question: What is the app's identifier in Apple's store portal?
Do we have to declare use of encryption?
Can I test the pipeline without actually shipping?
How do I see what the notification code did on a physical phone?
When does the system permission prompt first appear?
any_of: The system alert is never raised on sign-in

pairs.question: Why were requests at home slow and what fixed it?
What happens to a person's presence when location sharing is switched off?
What does the app do for people who turned on reduced motion?
Should switching tabs animate?
any_of: switches with no animation on the content

pairs.question: How much work may the main thread do per live update?
any_of: No work on the main thread proportional to the number of entities
